UserAdminOut.description: What admins see when managing users: includes activity so deletion can be an informed choice.
UserAdminOut.title: UserAdminOut

put.description:
Change your own password. Every other session of yours is signed out; this one stays signed in.

A wrong current password is a 400, not a 401: the web client treats 401 as "session expired".

schema.title: Response List Users Auth Users Get

delete.description:
Permanently delete a user. Their paper assignments are removed. If they have reviewed grades the
delete is refused (deactivate instead, which keeps the attribution) unless force=true, which keeps
the grades but clears who reviewed them.

patch.description:
Change a user's role and/or active flag. Takes effect immediately: the session cookie holds
only the user id, and role/active are read from the database on every request.

put.description:
Admin sets another user's password (e.g. they forgot it, or the account may be compromised).
All of that user's sessions are signed out. For your own account use PUT /auth/me/password, which
needs the current password, so a hijacked admin session can't quietly take the account over.

delete.description:
Permanently delete an exam: all rubric versions and every paper in it (grades, page images, stored PDFs).
An exam that still has papers needs force=true. Students are kept.

post.description:
Two layouts:
  - one PDF per student, named `<student_id>.pdf`
  - one combined PDF + a CSV giving each student's `first_page`/`last_page`
Call with dry_run=true first to preview, then repeat with dry_run=false to commit.
Queue every submission that is waiting (uploaded, e.g. imported before the rubric) or failed.
Rubrics are immutable; editing creates a new version so past grading runs stay traceable.

get.description: Is the grading backend usable? (e.g. is Claude logged in?) Shown as a banner to admins.

delete.description:
Permanently delete one paper: its grades, page images, grading history and assignments, and the
stored PDF. The student record stays. A paper with TA-reviewed grades needs force=true.
